settings.heading: Dr. Niki Serravalle
settings.bio:
I am a psychologist in Townsend, Delaware, and the founder of Center for Balanced Living.

For more than twenty years my clinical work has focused on treating trauma, alongside a personal passion for psychological evaluation.

I write Make It Make Sense, I teach other clinicians, and I wrote a memoir called The Stories We Told.
settings.quote: A space where the clinical, the literary, and the personal meet on the page.
settings.cite: Niki Serravalle, on why she writes

settings.title: The Stories We Told
settings.subtitle: The Dance Between a Codependent and a Compulsive Liar
settings.excerpt: He dug around, pulled an old receipt from his pocket, and even ran out to his truck to find a pen. Right there on the back of that crumpled slip, he sketched a small house. Simple. Nestled in the woods.
settings.hook: It’s finally time to tell the whole story.

settings.heading: Training for clinicians
settings.text:
The training ends. The case does not.

I teach the part the field quietly leaves to experience: what to do when the model stops working. Bring the one you are stuck on.
settings.caption: Clinical reasoning, sorted by the strength of its evidence.
